aboutUs.subtitle: About Us

story.title: Our Story
story.description: At TaskFlow, we believe productivity should be effortless and engaging. Our mission is to help individuals and teams organize, optimize, and accomplish more with the power of AI.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: We designed this platform to eliminate overwhelm, making task management smarter and more intuitive. Whether you're tackling daily to-dos, managing long-term projects, or looking to boost efficiency, our AI-driven system adapts to your workflow.

aboutUs.cta: Join us and redefine the way you work—one optimized task at a time.

features.subtitle: Features
features.title: Everything you need
features.description: Discover how our AI-powered features can transform your productivity

ai.title: AI-Powered Task Management
ai.description: Let AI handle the heavy lifting! Get intelligent task recommendations, automated scheduling, and optimized workflows tailored to your productivity style.

smart.title: Smart Task Creation & Editing
smart.description: Manually add tasks or let AI generate them for you. Modify, regenerate, or accept AI-suggested tasks effortlessly to match your needs.

gamified.title: Gamified Productivity
gamified.description: Stay motivated with streaks, achievements, and rewards as you complete tasks and hit your goals. Productivity has never been this fun!

sync.title: Cross-Platform Sync
sync.description: Seamlessly access your tasks from any device—whether you're on desktop or mobile, your progress is always in sync.

auth.title: Secure & Seamless Authentication
auth.description: Sign in easily with multiple providers while keeping your data safe. One account, total access.

insights.title: Insights & Progress Tracking
insights.description: Get real-time analytics on your productivity. Track your habits, monitor performance, and improve your workflow with data-driven insights.

whyUs.subtitle: Why Choose Us
whyUs.title: Experience the Difference
whyUs.description: Discover why thousands trust TaskFlow for their productivity needs

secure.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
secure.description: Your data is protected with state-of-the-art encryption

realTime.title: Real-Time Updates

accessible.title: Accessible Anywhere

comprehensive.title: AI-Powered Solutions

reviews.title: Freelance Developer

reviews.name: Emily Rodriguez
reviews.title: Marketing Director
reviews.message: The cross-platform sync is flawless, and the AI-powered insights have helped our team optimize our workflow in ways we never thought possible.

reviews.name: David Kim
reviews.title: Startup Founder
reviews.message: TaskFlow's enterprise features have scaled perfectly with our growing team. The customization options and integrations are exactly what we needed.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: At our company, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our application. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the application.

information.title: 2. Information We Collect
information.intro: We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our service to you:

items.personal: Personal Data: While using our Service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you ("Personal Data"). This may include, but is not limited to: email address, first and last name, phone number, address, and cookies.
items.usage: Usage Data: We may also collect information on how the Service is accessed and used ("Usage Data"). This data may include information such as your computer's Internet Protocol address (IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.
items.device: Device Data: We collect information about the device you use to access our Service, including the hardware model, operating system and version, unique device identifiers, and mobile network information.
items.cookies: Cookies and Tracking Data: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service and hold certain information.

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.intro: We use the collected data for various purposes:

purposes.serviceProvision: To provide and maintain our Service
purposes.improvement: To improve our Service and user experience
purposes.communication: To communicate with you about updates, support, and promotional offers (with opt-out options)
purposes.security: To detect, prevent and address technical issues and security risks

dataSharing.title: 4. Disclosure of Data
dataSharing.intro: We may disclose your personal information in the following situations:

parties.serviceProviders: Service Providers: We may employ third-party companies and individuals to facilitate our Service ("Service Providers"), to provide the Service on our behalf, to perform Service-related services or to assist us in analyzing how our Service is used. These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
parties.legal: Legal Requirements: We may disclose your Personal Data if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court or a government agency).
parties.business: Business Transfers: In connection with any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by another company.
parties.consent: With Your Consent: We may disclose your personal information for any other purpose with your consent.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service and hold certain information. Cookies are files with small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier.

essential.name: Essential Cookies
essential.description: Required for the operation of our website. They enable basic functions like page navigation and access to secure areas of the website.

analytics.name: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously.

functional.name: Functional Cookies
functional.description: Enable enhanced functionality and personalization, such as remembering your preferences and settings.

advertising.name: Advertising Cookies
advertising.description: Used to track visitors across websites to display relevant advertisements based on previous visits.

cookies.management: You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service.

security.title: 6. Data Security
security.content: The security of your data is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

thirdParty.title: 7. Links to Other Sites
thirdParty.content: Our Service may contain links to other sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party sites or services.

childrens.title: 8. Children's Privacy
childrens.content: Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 13. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with Personal Data, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected Personal Data from children without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers.

dataRetention.title: 9. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We will retain your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your Personal Data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

userRights.title: 10. Your Data Protection Rights
userRights.intro: Depending on your location and applicable laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data:

rights.access: The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
rights.rectification: The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate. You also have the right to request that we complete information you believe is incomplete.
rights.erasure: The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
rights.restriction: The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
rights.portability: The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.
rights.objection: The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the contact information provided on our website.
